description: Receive a stay purchase proof (SB-… ID, from a stay booked and paid through a GYOTAKU Protocol store window) with its claim code, and link it to your GYOTAK referral account. Works only through your personal token URL. Optional: show_referral puts your referral URL for that stay on the public proof page; handle links your own X account to the proof on the public chain (permanent; it cannot be removed). Call again with the same code to change show_referral or add an X account.

claim_code.description: Claim code shown with the booking status (SC-...)

handle.description: Your own X handle without @ (optional; recorded permanently on the public chain). Pass it only if the user explicitly asks.

show_referral.description: Show your referral URL for this stay on the public proof page (default false)

name: claim_stay_proof
title: Receive stay purchase proof
